picks.title: Nearly 80% of ACE Editors Surveyed Are Using AI, New Report Finds: 'You Adapt or Die'
picks.rationale: New Avid data: 77.5% of 120 ACE film editors already use AI. A hard industry number on how editing work is changing, from a whitelisted trade.
picks.excerpt: In an Avid survey of 120 members of the American Cinema Editors, 77.5% of film editors say they already use AI in their work, with editors describing the shift as 'adapt or die'.

picks.title: 4BY4 brings AI video enhancement to Mac, DaVinci Resolve and Nuke
picks.rationale: Concrete tool release: AI PIXELL PRO for macOS plus Resolve and Nuke plug-ins, with local processing and a perpetual license. Directly actionable for post teams.
picks.excerpt: 4BY4 will unveil AI PIXELL PRO for macOS plus DaVinci Resolve and Nuke plug-ins at Inter BEE on Nov. 18 - local processing, perpetual license, aimed at post-production of generated and existing video.

picks.title: When Video Becomes an Interface | inside view
picks.rationale: Primary-source Runway Labs look at real-time video prototypes (select-to-generate, video that re-renders on resize, sketch-to-animation), showing new interaction patterns for creators.
picks.excerpt: Inside Runway Labs, designers prototype what real-time video models enable: select anywhere to generate, video that re-renders as you resize it, and a drawing app that animates sketches in your style as you draw.

picks.title: This Startup Is Betting on AI Microdramas to Get More Black Stories in Hollywood
picks.rationale: Mansa uses AI microdramas as proof-of-concept pilots for underserved audiences. A new development-pipeline angle, with the critics' pushback included.
picks.excerpt: Mansa says its AI-generated microdramas can serve as proofs of concept for what Black audiences want; critics say the studio is selling out.

picks.title: Animaj Brings 'Ozzy Fox' Series to Disney Plus as It Charts a Path for AI in Animation
picks.rationale: Follow-up to the 11-06 FlipMove workflow card, with a new concrete event: the AI-assisted Disney Jr. series Ozzy Fox moves to Disney+, plus details of the agentic animation pipeline.
picks.excerpt: Animaj's AI-assisted preschool series Ozzy Fox, made with Disney Jr., moves to Disney+ as the studio details how animators use its agentic AI pipeline.
